accessBasis.gate: Company-scope settings category (SettingsScope.company) is hidden from non-admins by SettingsCatalog.visibleCategories and guarded in the router; the screen itself has no feature key.

behaviourReviewed: Six generic GST slots; a slot's red star follows gstGenericSlotIsRequired and stops being required once every rate row for that side/tax is filled.
Rate-specific rows are added on screen via the Add a rate chips or the Add a GST rate dialog; no hardcoded slab list.
gstLedgerConfigIsComplete resolves a rate through its rate key first, then its generic key; Save is disabled otherwise.
Optional ledgers (Round Off, Additional Charge, Discount, TDS) never block Save.

Extra charge/discount rows: blank row ignored, half-filled row blocks Save with a per-row reason, duplicate name refused, duplicate ledger refused (including against a fixed slot) because SalesInvoiceService merges entries sharing a ledger_id.
Reverse-charge card is collapsed by default and carries its own explanatory subtitle.
Misdirected-GST banner is a warning, not a block, and is the only place a customer learns tax is landing on another rate's ledger.
LedgerConfigGuard shows Setup Required / Configure Ledgers before invoice creation when the mapping is incomplete.
screenExplanationsPreserved: Info banner: Create missing ledgers in Tally, then sync to see them here.
deliberatelyOmitted: No tax-law guidance on which rate or which ledger a business should use.
Internal config keys (output_cgst, extra_1) are not exposed to readers.
